alc-alif.title: The Letter Alif أ In Arabic
alc-alif.quote: Place your pen slightly above the writing line. Draw a straight downward line until you touch the baseline.

alc-haa.title: The Letter Haa ح In Arabic
alc-haa.quote: Start with a rounded curve starting from the top right, forming an open loop.
